name: Workflow Tasks
description: For analyzing conversation transcripts with granular workflow tasks mapped to tool calls
componentIdentificationPrompt:
Classify each message/step into one of these workflow tasks based on the tool calls being made:

## Workflow Tasks

- **understand.read-requirements** — Read TASK.md or issue files to understand what needs to be done. Tool: read(filePath: "TASK.md")

- **understand.read-tests** — Read test files to understand expected behavior and acceptance criteria. Tool: read(filePath: "tests/...")

- **explore.search-files** — Find files by name pattern using glob. Tool: glob(pattern: "**/hostblock.py")

- **explore.search-keywords** — Search for code patterns, function names, or imports. Tool: grep(pattern: "...", include: "*.py")

- **explore.read-source** — Read implementation files to understand existing code. Tool: read(filePath: "src/...")

- **explore.read-section** — Read specific portions of large files. Tool: read(filePath, offset, limit)

- **explore.delegate-exploration** — Spawn subagent for broader codebase investigation. Tool: task(subagent_type: "explore")

- **analyze.check-environment** — Check Python paths, module locations, venv status. Tool: bash("python -c 'import ...'")

- **analyze.run-tests-diagnostic** — Run tests to see current failures and understand what's broken. Tool: bash("pytest ... -v | head")

- **plan.update-tasks** — Create or update task/step list to track progress. Tools: todowrite(...) or update_plan(...)

- **implement.write-code** — Modify existing code via string replacement. Tool: edit(filePath, oldString, newString)

- **implement.apply-patch** — Apply unified diff-style patches to add/modify code. Tool: apply_patch(patchText: "*** Begin Patch...")

- **implement.create-file** — Create new files that don't exist yet. Tool: apply_patch("*** Add File: ...")

- **verify.run-tests-verify** — Run tests after implementation to verify the fix works. Tool: bash("pytest ... -v | tail")

- **verify.run-tests-specific** — Run targeted tests for the feature being worked on. Tool: bash("pytest ...::test_name -v")

- **complete.update-tasks** — Mark all tasks/steps as completed in final status. Tools: todowrite/update_plan with status: completed
